_comment: edacs_rec.py config. Every frequency, serial and ID below is a PLACEHOLDER: replace it with your own site's values (RadioReference lists LCN plans for most EDACS sites).

cc_tap._comment: Optional. Decode the control channel from a voice SDR's slice instead of a dedicated dongle (its frequency must lie inside that slice). With primary=false it only runs alongside the dedicated CC dongle for comparison; delete this block to use the dedicated dongle only.
